entries.text:
Investigate slow query on invoices table
The invoices list endpoint p95 latency jumped from 200ms to 1.8s after the new filter was added. Missing index on (account_id, created_at).

Fix pagination bug in leads export
The leads CSV export drops the last page of results when the page size does not evenly divide the total count. Root cause: an off-by-one in the offset calculation.

Support bulk user deactivation
Admins need to deactivate more than one user at a time from the team settings page instead of one by one.

Duplicate notifications on reconnect
A flaky websocket reconnect re-sends the last three notifications, which shows up as duplicates in the notification center.

Add retry logic to webhook delivery
Webhook deliveries currently fail silently on a 5xx from the customer endpoint. Add exponential backoff with a max of 5 attempts over 24 hours.

Timezone bug in scheduled reports
Scheduled reports fire at UTC midnight instead of the account timezone midnight, confusing customers in non-UTC regions.

API Key Rotation
To rotate an API key, generate a new key in the Settings > Credentials panel,
update every service that consumes it, then revoke the old key after
confirming the new one is live in production. Keys should be rotated every
90 days per the security policy. Never commit a raw key to source control —
use the secrets manager instead.

API Versioning Policy (archived)
Archived: the old policy versioned every endpoint independently, which made
client upgrades unpredictable. Superseded by the unified versioning policy
below.

API Versioning Policy
The whole API is versioned together as /v1, /v2, etc. A version is
supported for at least 12 months after the next version ships, with
deprecation notices sent 90 days before end-of-life.

Billing Invoice Cycle
Invoices generate on the first of each month based on the previous month's
usage. Customers on annual plans are billed once and see monthly usage
reports without a charge. Failed payments retry three times over ten days
before the account is suspended.

Code Review Standards
Every PR needs one approval before merge, two for changes touching the
payments service. Reviewers should respond within one business day.
Nitpicks belong in a single top-level comment, not scattered across the
diff, so the author can address them in one pass.

Customer Data Retention
Account data is retained for 90 days after account deletion to allow
recovery, then permanently purged. Audit logs are kept for 7 years for
compliance. A data deletion request from a customer must be honored within
30 days per the privacy policy.

Database Backup Policy
Production databases are snapshotted every six hours with a 30-day retention
window. Point-in-time recovery is available for the last 7 days via the
transaction log. Restores should be tested quarterly in the staging
environment to confirm the backups are actually usable.

Deployment Pipeline
Every merge to main triggers a build, a full test suite run, and a canary
deploy to 5% of production traffic. If error rates stay flat for 15 minutes
the canary promotes automatically to 100%. Rollbacks are a single click in
the deploy dashboard and take under two minutes.

Feature Flag Guidelines
Every new feature ships behind a flag defaulted to off. Flags should be
removed within one release cycle of reaching 100% rollout — a codebase
survey found flags left in for over a year account for a third of dead code.
Use the naming convention team-feature-shortdesc.

Incident Response Runbook
Declare an incident in the #incidents channel and page the on-call engineer.
Sev1 incidents require a status page update within 10 minutes. After
resolution, write a blameless postmortem within 48 hours covering timeline,
root cause, and follow-up action items.

Local Dev Environment Setup
Clone the monorepo, run the bootstrap script, and copy .env.example to .env.
The bootstrap script installs dependencies for every workspace and seeds a
local database with fixture data. Most services hot-reload on save; the
worker processes need a manual restart.

Mobile Release Checklist
Before submitting to the App Store, run the full regression suite on the
three oldest supported OS versions, verify the changelog matches the
release notes, and confirm crash-free sessions are above 99.5% on the beta
track for at least 48 hours.

Onboarding New Engineers
New engineers get repo access on day one, a laptop provisioned with the
standard dev image, and a 30-minute pairing session with their onboarding
buddy. The first task is always a small, well-scoped bug fix to get familiar
with the review process before taking on larger work.

On-call Rotation Schedule
Rotations are weekly, Monday to Monday, with a secondary on-call as backup.
Swap requests go through the on-call bot at least 24 hours in advance.
Compensation for a quiet week (zero pages) is a half-day off the following
sprint.

Password Reset Flow (deprecated)
Older flow: user requests reset, receives an email with a 24-hour link,
sets a new password. Deprecated in favor of the v2 flow with a shorter TTL
and stronger throttling.

Password Reset Flow (current)
Current flow: user requests a reset, receives a one-time 15-minute link,
sets a new password, and every other session is invalidated. Requests are
throttled to 3 per hour per account to prevent abuse.

Frontend Performance Budget
The main bundle must stay under 250KB gzipped and the largest contentful
paint under 2.5 seconds on a throttled 4G connection. CI fails the build if
either budget is exceeded, with an explicit override required to merge
anyway.

Rate Limiting Policy
The public API allows 100 requests per minute per API key, with a burst
allowance of 20. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After
header. Enterprise plans can request a higher limit through account
management.

Search Relevance Tuning
Relevance is tuned by blending cosine similarity from the embedding model
with a BM25 lexical score, weighted 65/35. Query expansion adds simple
synonym and plural variants before scoring. Regressions are caught with a
labeled query set checked into the eval harness.

SSO Configuration
SAML and OIDC are both supported for enterprise customers. Configuration
requires the customer's identity provider metadata URL, a mapped attribute
for email, and an optional group-to-role mapping. Test SSO in a staging
tenant before enabling it for the production org.

Support Escalation Tiers
Tier 1 handles account and billing questions with a 24-hour SLA. Tier 2
handles technical issues requiring engineering context, 8-hour SLA. Tier 3
is a direct escalation to the on-call engineer, reserved for outages
affecting more than 10% of customers.

Vendor Security Review
Any third-party vendor handling customer data requires a security
questionnaire, a signed data processing agreement, and sign-off from the
security team before the contract is finalized. Reviews are refreshed
annually for vendors still in use.
